Project # 9 :    DARTT  
Team Size         :  4  
Tech Stack: Angular, Node.js, NestJS, Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, TypeScript, REST APIs, Git, 
Agile/Scrum 
Project Description: 
 Developing an enterprise recruitment and manpower management application for Bosch to streamline hiring 
requests, resource planning, and workforce tracking.  
 Built responsive and reusable UI components using Angular, following a modular and scalable architecture.  
 Developed secure RESTful APIs using NestJS and Node.js to manage recruitment workflows, manpower 
requests, approvals, and user operations.  
 Integrated Apache Kafka for event-driven communication, enabling asynchronous processing of recruitment 
and manpower events.  
 Implemented Elasticsearch to provide high-performance search, filtering, and indexing across recruitment 
requests and manpower records.  
 Designed scalable backend modules following clean architecture and dependency injection principles in 
NestJS.  
 Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions 
while following Agile development practices.  
 Optimized application performance through efficient API design, lazy loading, and reusable component 
architecture.  
 Participated in code reviews, bug fixes, production support, and continuous feature enhancements while 
maintaining high code quality. 
Project # 8 : BAUSCH + LOMB 
Team Size : 4 
Tech Stack : REACT with NEXT js and Daisy UI, FAST API, python, MS SQL, Tailwind CSS, RBAC 
 
Description: Developed an internal enterprise productivity monitoring application for Bausch + Lomb focused on 
collecting and analyzing real-time machine data. The application enables administrators to monitor machine 
performance, production metrics, and operational insights through interactive dashboards and reports. Operators 
can log breaks, report issues, and update machine statuses, ensuring accurate shop-floor visibility. Implemented 
secure role-based access to differentiate admin and operator functionalities, improving operational efficiency and 
workforce productivity. The system supports robust data workflows, advanced tabular analysis, and visual 
reporting to help management make data-driven decisions. 
 
Responsibilities: 
 Developed modular React + Next.js components with Tailwind CSS and Daisy UI for clean UI, responsive 
layouts, and reusable design patterns. 
Utilized Pre-React Signals to build highly reactive forms and state -driven UIs without relying on third-party 
state management libraries. 
 Implemented WebSockets to stream real-time machine status updates, operator actions, and dashboard 
refreshes without page reloads. 
 role-based access control (RBAC) to secure routes, APIs, and user permissions. 
 Developed and consumed RESTful APIs using FAST API with Python for machine data ingestion, operator 
actions, audit logs, and permission configurations.
Project # 7 : Digital BOM 
Team Size :  4 
Tech Stack : REACT with VITE and Tailwind CSS, Node with Express JS MS SQL, Tailwind 
CSS, RBAC 
 
Description: Developed an internal enterprise application focused on tracking and managing parts across 
different stations within a manufacturing plant. The system enables users to monitor the real-time location and 
movement of parts, ensuring complete visibility of production flow. Administrators can add, modify, and manage 
parts based on plant configurations, while also controlling how components move between stations. The 
application improves traceability, reduces manual errors, and enhances operational efficiency by providing 
structured workflows, real-time updates, and data-driven insights into part distribution and station utilization. 
 
Responsibilities: 
❖ Developed modular React + Vite components with Tailwind CSS for clean UI, responsive layouts, and 
reusable design patterns. 
❖ Utilized Pre-React Signals to build highly reactive forms and state-driven UIs without relying on third-party 
state management libraries. 
❖ Developed and consumed RESTful APIs using Node with Express js 
 
 
Project # 6 : ONE VAL 
Team Size : 4 
Tech Stack : Angular 18 (Standalone Components, Signals),Node With Nest js, 
PostgreSQL, AG Grid, AG Charts, Tailwind CSS, Keycloak, Docker,Jenkins 
 
Description: Developed an internal enterprise application for vehicle audit and validation at Renault. The project 
focused on robust data workflows, real-time reporting, and secure role-based access. Leveraged Angular 18 
standalone components with Signals for reactive state management, integrated AG Grid for advanced tabular 
data operations, and used AG Charts for visual dashboards. Backend was built using Node with Nest js and 
integrated with secure Keycloak SSO. 
Responsibilities: 
❖ Developed modular Angular standalone components with Tailwind CSS for clean UI and 
responsive layouts. 
❖ Utilized Angular Signals to build highly reactive forms and state-driven UIs without third-
party state management libraries. 
❖ Implemented AG Grid for handling large-scale datasets with pagination, sorting, filtering, row 
selection, and cell editing. 
❖ Integrated AG Charts to deliver real-time insights and interactive dashboards for audit analytics. 
❖ Used Keycloak for SSO, OAuth2, and role-based access control (RBAC) to secure route and 
API access. 
❖ Developed and consumed RESTful APIs using Node with Nest js for inspection 
workflows, audit logs, and permission configurations. 
❖ Containerized backend services using Docker and deployed through CI/CD pipelines in 
Jenkins. 
❖ Used PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA to manage relational audit records with validations and 
optimized queries.
